purpose: Mechanistic diagnostic on all 20 existing dev pages after open-answer candidate ceiling of 16. Compare the log odds of the two published answers under actual equal-format, date-free old and new single-snapshot prompts. The two answers enter teacher forcing only; no claim of deployable open QA. Evaluate open greedy answers from both prompt endpoints as controls. Compute all 8 combinations of frozen full-attention KV, recurrent convolution history and recurrent matrices; average all six marginal orderings for exact three-feature Shapley decomposition. Attention donor determines its own positions, so attribution includes positional offsets and is conditional on these two specific cache realizations.
gate: Consider a next native intervention only if >=4 of the 6 pages missed by the prior 4B mixed baseline have positive total paired gap >.05 nats/token AND positive recurrent contribution >.05; report the same counts for attention and convolution, medians, sign-exact full forced-choice per edition, and outcomes on all 20. If the same signal is stronger in attention, retain attention as the main comparison. Do not infer open-answer gain from forced-choice margins.
budget: Local Qwen3.5-4B, 20 pages, 160 cache combinations, 40 free generations, 12 minutes maximum, one engineering repair. No reserve access and no paid compute.
